5. **Subtract 80 refunds of 96,898:** 4,001,130 - (80 × 96,898) = 4,001,130 - 7,751,840 = -3,750,710
6. **Add 38 deposits of 93,867:** -3,750,710 + (38 × 93,867) = -3,750,710 + 3,566,946 = **-183,764**
